start.text: Check a Rito postbox for a letter.

letter.text:
Dear Link,
a storm took my lantern and my mast,
so I can't tell my tales on Windfall
this year. I enclose a notebook to keep
this tale in, and a sealed letter: please
bring it to my old friend at the harbour.

steps.text: Bring the storyteller's letter to his old friend at Windfall's harbour (by day).

lines: A letter from my old friend? Thank you!
This year I'll tell the tales in his place.
He paid in stories; let me pay you in rupees.
